context: A teen tells her mother about last night and exchange-student friends
purpose: Teach: 昨夜/皮膚/棒/手前/即/文法/留学生/毒

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえお母さん、昨夜のことなんだけど、留学生の友達と遅くまで話してたの。
lines.en: Hey Mom, about last night, I was talking with my exchange-student friends until late.
lines.style: Casual teen voice with affectionate tone toward her mother

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ああ、そうだったの。でも顔色が悪いし、皮膚科の先生に診てもらったほうがいいんじゃない?
lines.en: Oh, I see. But you look pale — maybe you should see the dermatologist?
lines.style: Warm motherly tone showing gentle concern about her daughter's health

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫だよ。ジェイクが英語の文法の宿題をずっと手伝ってくれてたんだ。
lines.en: I'm fine. Jake was helping me with my English grammar homework the whole time.
lines.style: Reassuring upbeat teen explaining her late evening to her mom

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、優しい子ね。でもあの子、毒舌だって言ってなかった?
lines.en: Wow, what a kind boy. But didn't you say he had a venomous tongue?
lines.style: Curious teasing mother recalling earlier stories about her friends

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あはは、確かに毒はあるけど、面白いんだよ。長い棒を振り回して笑わせてくれてさ。
lines.en: Haha, sure he's got a venomous side, but he's funny. He kept swinging a long stick around to make us laugh.
lines.style: Laughing teen recounting silly moments with her exchange-student friends

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう、危ないわね。家の手前の公園でやってたの?ご近所迷惑よ。
lines.en: Goodness, that's dangerous. Were you doing that in the park just before our house? It bothers the neighbors.
lines.style: Mildly scolding maternal tone with practical neighborhood concern

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっとだけだよ。お母さんに言われたら即やめるから、安心して。
lines.en: Just for a bit. If you tell me to, I'll stop immediately, so don't worry.
lines.style: Slightly defensive but obedient teen reassuring her mother

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ならいいけど。今度その留学生のお友達、うちに連れていらっしゃい。
lines.en: Well, alright then. Next time, bring those exchange-student friends over to our house.
lines.style: Forgiving warm mother extending a hospitality invitation to her daughter
